sentences.text: Look at the sky at night.
The stars are small points of light.
It is a big, hot star.
It is very close to us.
We use big tools to look.
The tools are also in space.
We look for a special world.
Are there other worlds with water?
Are we alone in the sky?
There are many stars and many worlds.

questions.text: What do you see at night?
What do we call other planets?
What do we use to look for planets?
What is important on a world like Earth?
Do we live on a star?
